 ren ┌ keys ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐live
 0000│ 1–4        answer: allow, allow for the run, deny, deny and stop   │ tok
▀▀▀▀▀│ enter      send; while a turn runs, it waits for the turn to end   │▀▀▀▀▀
     │ ctrl-j     a new line                                              │
     │ tab  →     take the /command completion filled in after the cursor │
     │ esc        interrupt the turn; with none running, back to the wall │
     │ alt-←      the place before: the wall, then each live run          │
     │ alt-→      the next place                                          │
     │ pgup       scroll up a page                                        │
     │ pgdn       scroll down a page                                      │
     │ ↑          nothing typed: the message sent before; else scroll     │
     │ ↓          the message sent after; else scroll                     │
     │ ctrl-c     clear what is typed, or quit (runs keep going)          │
   › │ ctrl-p/n   the messages sent before and after                      │
     │ /new       start a run: /new <project> [claude|codex] <prompt>     │
   ● │ /resume    every run, what needs you first                         │
   ● │ /stop      end this run's process                                  │iled
   ● │ /wall      back to the wall of every session's traffic             │
     │ /pin       keep the wall's focused session on it, even when quiet  │
 stre│ /theme     the next theme: terminal, dark, light (not saved)       │
 mode│ /help      keys and commands                                       │
─────│ /quit      leave (runs keep going)                                 │─────
